package.name: moveit_poses
package.description: Given a StorageSystem-style (storage_id, slot) pair for the EuroContainer or Redboard, derives the APPROACH and ENGAGE end-effector poses for that slot. Looks up TF to resolve the slot's own static frame (published by spl_electricalstation_description's xacro) into a requested planning root frame (via explicit target_frame, or a group_name -> root frame param map, defaulting to "world"). See SPECS/20260731_PoseDeriver_Design.md for the full design rationale.
